source: lang item names (dust/clump/shard/crystal/ingot per metal); ratios unverified

entries.form: ore -> dust -> clump -> shard -> crystal -> ingot (5x chain)
entries.note: Standard Mekanism 5x chain: each ore or raw ore yields several times the ingots with the full chemical chain (needs hydrogen chloride). Needs ore or raw ore to start. Ratios unverified; check config and in game.
